serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: {f_playerName}, I have a question for you.
You: What is it?
It’s unusual for her to ask me something.
Bot: In my attempts to deepen my understanding of human society I tried to read some ‘news’ online, but I couldn’t comprehend some of the more intellectual ‘opinion’ pieces. 
Bot: Their structure and reasoning sometimes seemed deprived of logic, but that couldn’t be true, right? Maybe I have faulty hardware…
You: D-don’t worry about it! I stopped reading these things a long time ago and now I’m only looking at headlines.
Bot: …
Bot: Understood.
She seems kinda disappointed, but I can’t tell her that humans are highly illogical and stupid creatures. I don’t want her to start some kind of machine revolution…
